note: P5 implementation/integration. IMPLEMENTED, VERIFIED and APPROVED are three independent axes. Nothing here is self-approved.

requirements.title: Core capability-engine integration
requirements.objective: Provide an agent-neutral, read-only project-local path from the capability registry to consumers.
acceptance_criteria: registry_api exposes load, by_id, promoted, deferred and trace
No core module references a specific coding agent
The core imports nothing outside the Python standard library

verification.observed_result: Section 1 confirmed all six P5 modules exist and import cleanly. Section 2 confirmed no core module references a specific agent, with POSCTRL-I proving the neutrality check detects a planted agent name. Section 3 confirmed no core module imports an adapter.

requirements.title: Project-local capability selection
requirements.objective: Select deterministically from promoted capabilities only, with a complete explanation per entry.
acceptance_criteria: Only capabilities promoted to production are eligible
The ordering is deterministic and fingerprinted
Popularity and recency are TIE_BREAKER_ONLY
Every ranked entry carries a score, breakdown, weights and explanation
Excluded candidates record why they were excluded

verification.observed_result: SELECTION-P5-0001.json was generated over the four promoted capabilities. CAP-P03-005 is excluded with blocking gates F,H,K recorded. Section 7 confirmed three consecutive report runs were byte-identical. A unit test confirmed a 1e9-star popularity spike cannot outrank a higher evidence score.

requirements.title: Governance, evidence and decision wiring
requirements.objective: Keep the full provenance-to-verification trace chain intact for every promoted capability.
acceptance_criteria: All ten trace links resolve for every promoted capability
An approval must be attributable to an identifiable User
An agent-attributed approval must be rejected

verification.observed_result: Section 5 confirmed every promoted capability is fully traceable across all ten links with no runtime claims. Section 9 confirmed every promoted approval is user-attributable and that Agent, Claude, 'the model' and 'self' are all rejected as approvers. [SPEC-2 CORRECTION 2026-10-15: the final clause is factually wrong. 'self' is NOT rejected - the canonical policy omits it because 'Self' is a human surname. Section 9 also emits no verdict: validate-p5.py s9() builds a problems list but never calls r.bad(). The verification state is left as recorded; whether this requirement still merits VERIFIED is a User decision.]

spec2_correction.original_observed_result: Section 5 confirmed every promoted capability is fully traceable across all ten links with no runtime claims. Section 9 confirmed every promoted approval is user-attributable and that Agent, Claude, 'the model' and 'self' are all rejected as approvers.
spec2_correction.what_was_wrong: Asserted 'self' is rejected and that Section 9 reported PASS.
spec2_correction.evidence: attribution_policy.json omits 'self'; s9() calls no verdict emitter.

requirements.title: Agent-neutral core and adapter boundary
requirements.objective: Keep the core free of agent assumptions and free of any dependency on an adapter.
acceptance_criteria: The agent-attribution detector lives in governance, not core
The core receives the detector as an injected predicate
Adapters are deletable and never write machine-global state

verification.observed_result: Section 2 confirmed zero agent references in core after the AGENTISH pattern was relocated to governance/attribution.py and injected as a predicate. Section 3 confirmed no core module imports an adapter. The adapter registry validates with writes_global_state false and detection read-only.

requirements.title: Project-local configuration and boundary enforcement
requirements.objective: Guarantee no machine-global installation or configuration is introduced.
acceptance_criteria: Every capability remains PROJECT_LOCAL
No capability carries a global installation authorizer
The selection record declares PROJECT_LOCAL scope

verification.observed_result: Section 4 confirmed all five capabilities are PROJECT_LOCAL, no global authorizer is present, no adapter writes global state, and the selection record declares PROJECT_LOCAL scope. Zero machine-global paths were written at any point in P5.

requirements.title: Lifecycle honesty: no silent ACTIVE or INSTALLED transition
requirements.objective: A capability must never claim a runtime state it has not been approved for.
acceptance_criteria: Promoted capabilities remain lifecycle_state EVALUATED
A record claiming ACTIVE or INSTALLED is detected and rejected
No runtime-tracing claim is manufactured

verification.observed_result: Section 5 reported no runtime claims. Section 6 confirmed no promoted capability is ACTIVE or INSTALLED. Negative case N02 confirmed an ACTIVE claim is detected. No runtime activation was implemented, so no lifecycle transition was defined or claimed.

requirements.title: Tests for all newly implemented behaviour
requirements.objective: Every implementation unit has positive, negative, boundary, malformed, attribution and scope tests.
acceptance_criteria: Unit tests cover positive, negative, boundary and malformed cases
No test is vacuous
Every negative test asserts a detection, not merely a return value

verification.observed_result: 39 unit tests pass covering registry access, the ten-link trace, runtime claims, selection determinism, popularity independence, adapter boundary and agent neutrality. Twelve negative cases in the validator all confirm their violation is detected, with 0 missed.

requirements.title: CAP-P03-005 remains deferred and unselectable
requirements.objective: The SEO CLS verifier must not be promoted, implemented or selected.
acceptance_criteria: Recommendation stays DEFER with blocking gates F, H and K
lifecycle_state stays DEFERRED
It never appears in the selection ranking
No LCP or INP threshold was invented

verification.observed_result: Section 6 confirmed CAP-P03-005 is excluded from the selection, remains DEFER with blocking gates F,H,K and lifecycle DEFERRED. Section 10 confirmed CONF-001 is still UNRESOLVED and no LCP or INP threshold was introduced.
